test_title: PYST 6: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following correctly describes the Planning Commission of India?

options.text: A constitutional body established by an Article of the Constitution.
A statutory body created by an Act of Parliament in 1950.
A constitutional commission chaired by the Chief Justice of India.
An extra-constitutional advisory body created by a government resolution in 1950.

solution:
The correct answer is __**An extra-constitutional advisory body created by a government resolution in 1950**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Planning Commission of India was established through a **government resolution** by the Cabinet in **March 1950**. It was not created under any constitutional article or statute.
 
• The Planning Commission was tasked with the **responsibility of formulating five-year plans** for the socio-economic development of the nation.
 
• It was an **advisory body** that worked under the chairmanship of the Prime Minister and had no direct executive power.
 
• The Planning Commission aimed to **assess resources, formulate plans, and allocate funds** for various sectors of the economy.
 
• The Commission was replaced by the **NITI Aayog** (National Institution for Transforming India) in **January 2015**, which focuses on fostering cooperative federalism and providing strategic and technical advice.
